title: The Family Next Door (TV series)
premise_summary: The Family Next Door is an Australian television drama series which began airing on 10 August 2025 on ABC Television. Based on the novel of the same name by Sally Hepworth, the series follows the enigmatic Isabelle, who moves into a small seaside cul-de-sac, where her obsessive drive to solve a mystery casts suspicion on four neighbouring families.
